scenarios.title: Trading rules — a Low deficit made good by a Medium surplus, beside a Medium deficit
scenarios.description: Area: a Low grassland is enhanced into a Medium one, so the Low band loses units and the Medium grassland gains more, while two Medium heathlands are built over. The heathland deficit breaches the Medium rule, as no other Medium broad habitat may make it good, but the grassland surplus still covers the Low loss, so the Low rule is met. This is the case the published metric gets wrong: it nets the heathland deficit off the grassland surplus before offering it to the Low band, and so reports the Low rule breached. The workbooks correct that bug (METRIC_CORRECTIONS in the workbook writer).
